title: Review the 5ZV correction, then plan Calm's pre-paper execution and evidence
kind: REVIEW + PLAN. No order-send implementation, and none authorised.

verdict.calm_contract: still TRADABLE, Option A, the 10:00 open
verdict.shadow_evidence_now: the DECISION half - that the route would have acted
verdict.paper_only: that an order was accepted, the fill, the slippage, a resting stop

review_of_the_correction.the_claim: Calm's stop is entry minus 1.5 x ATR, so a concrete stop price cannot be known before the 10:00 entry reference exists
review_of_the_correction.verified: disaster_stop(entry, atr) = entry - mult x atr, read from source. The stop LEVEL requires the entry price. The first draft of 5ZV put planned_stop in the before-entry group, which would have shadow record a price it cannot compute - the same error as recording the reference price early.

and_sharpened.measured: two entries, one ATR: 5000.00 gives stop 4982.00 (distance 18.00); 5123.75 gives stop 5105.75 (distance 18.00)
and_sharpened.so: the stop DISTANCE is 1.5 x ATR and is entry-INDEPENDENT; the dollar risk is distance x point_value x qty and cancels the entry out; and qty is a fixed sleeve constant SLEEVE_QTY['roska4_calm'], not risk-derived. ONLY THE STOP LEVEL waits for 10:00. That is a sharper statement than 'the stop is not known', and it is what justifies stop_rule + risk_inputs before and planned_stop after.

review_of_the_correction.runtime_files_touched_by_the_edits: none. live_positions.track1.json and the checkpoint moved at 15:56:24 ET because the SWING window closed - the route wrote them, and the book came through still schema 2, route-stamped, no foreign keys. That is the third window close the Stage 5ZS repair has survived.
review_of_the_correction.docs_were_NOT_consistent_and_are_now: the 5ZV markdown listed planned_stop under before-entry in its code block and contradicted itself five lines later in the correction paragraph. The block, the JSON and the pipeline doc are now aligned - the block is the thing a reader copies.

tests_run.nothing loosened: the repairs were to stale ROSTER and DATE pins, not to safety assertions

1_production_wiring_still_missing.DECIDE ~09:32: MISSING. Nothing computes the setup from the closed 09:30 bar and records an intent. Today's single Calm slot fires at 10:00 and does everything at once.
1_production_wiring_still_missing.SEND 10:00:00: MISSING BY DESIGN, and must stay missing. run_live_day_track1 builds NoOrderBroker unconditionally; UnbuiltPaperExecutor is the placeholder.
1_production_wiring_still_missing.OBSERVE 10:01+: MISSING. The 5ZU gate can now read the 10:00 OPEN from a closed one-minute bar, but nothing records it as the reference.

2_jobs_or_slot_or_stream.answer: two scheduler jobs and ONE new evidence stream
2_jobs_or_slot_or_stream.why_not_one_expanded_slot: a slot that starts at 09:32 and finishes after 10:01 would hold a process and a client id across the entry instant, and a crash anywhere in that half hour loses both halves. The phases have different inputs and different failure modes; a slot that spans them cannot report which failed.
2_jobs_or_slot_or_stream.why_not_reuse_a_stream: every existing stream already has a reader that counts it. shadow/ holds per-slot explanations; a reader counting rows there would start counting intents.
2_jobs_or_slot_or_stream.shape: TRACK1_CALM_DECIDE_0932 (one_shot) and TRACK1_CALM_OBSERVE_1002 (one_shot), replacing TRACK1_CALM_1000. Net +1 job.
2_jobs_or_slot_or_stream.cost: the scheduler goes from 101 jobs to 102

3_how_shadow_counts_without_pretending_a.rule: a Calm day is judgeable when the DECIDE phase decided causally from bars closed at or before 09:31, an intent was recorded before 10:00, and the OBSERVE phase recorded the 10:00 reference afterwards
3_how_shadow_counts_without_pretending_a.what_it_certifies: the route would have acted, and at what reference
3_how_shadow_counts_without_pretending_a.what_it_does_not: that an order would have been accepted, filled, or filled near that reference
3_how_shadow_counts_without_pretending_a.how_the_gate_should_say_it: PAPER_SHADOW_EVIDENCE should carry the label it is counting - decision_judgeable - so a later reader cannot mistake five clean days for five proven executions

4_what_must_stay_separate_from_the_order.answer: shadow intent gets its own stream: global_index/track1_runtime/shadow_intent/
4_what_must_stay_separate_from_the_order.why_this_is_not_a_preference: FOUR readers treat the EXISTENCE of track1_runtime/orders/ as proof the route acted
the_four: b1_book_repair.route_has_never_traded - refuses the book repair if it exists
track1_paper_callsite - guards the production root against it
track1_report - reports NOT_PRODUCED while it is absent
the shadow-window runbook - 'an order journal was written, stop and investigate'
4_what_must_stay_separate_from_the_order.consequence_if_ignored: a shadow intent written there would make all four report a route that traded, on a day it sent nothing - and it would block its own book repair
4_what_must_stay_separate_from_the_order.pinned: scratch/test_track1_stage5zw_calm_prepaper_execution_20260827.py holds this before anyone implements it

5_what_changes_later_to_send_at_10_00.one_job: a SEND job at 10:00:00 that reads the recorded intent and calls the executor. It reads NO bars - that is what makes it free of future data.
5_what_changes_later_to_send_at_10_00.one_swap: UnbuiltPaperExecutor becomes a real executor holding an IBKRBroker, built and proven separately
5_what_changes_later_to_send_at_10_00.one_promotion: the shadow intent becomes an INTENDED row in the real order journal at the moment the route is armed - the same fields, a different stream, and the promotion is the act that says this is no longer a rehearsal
5_what_changes_later_to_send_at_10_00.unchanged: the DECIDE and OBSERVE phases, their times, and the entry reference. That is the point of building them now.

6_what_remains_blocked.PAPER_SHADOW_EVIDENCE: 3 of 5 judgeable days. Calm contributes none until the DECIDE and OBSERVE jobs exist, because its slot still refuses.
6_what_remains_blocked.B1: no decision recorded. The measurement passes on a record from 11:34 ET and expires 24h later, so it needs re-running the day the decision is made.
6_what_remains_blocked.the_SEND_wire: does not exist, and this stage does not build it

a_finding_recorded_not_fixed.what: ORDERS_DIR is defined independently in three modules - track1_order_journal, b1_book_repair and track1_report - while a fourth references the shared constant.
a_finding_recorded_not_fixed.risk: three definitions of one path drift silently; the readers that prove the route has not traded would start looking in different places
a_finding_recorded_not_fixed.done: a test asserts they still agree, which fails the day they stop - the only way anyone would find out
a_finding_recorded_not_fixed.not_done: collapsing them to one import, which belongs to whoever next touches that path
